Date format

Century: 20. st. or 20.st. or 20st

Year: 1968

Month: 8.1968

Day: 21.8.1968

Hours, minutes, seconds: 21.8.1968 2:43 or 21.8.1968 8:23:31

Intervals

Years: 1968-1969

Combination: 8.1968-1969 or 21.8.1968 2:43-27.6.1989

Estimate

Defined by enclosing the value in round or square brackets:

E.g.: [16.8.1977] or [1990]-1992

When the '/' character is used to separate an interval, both from and to are treated as an estimate:

E.g.: 1985/1990
